findings.title: [P1] Preserve tenant isolation when authorizing document reads
findings.body: Returning true unconditionally allows users to read documents belonging to any tenant. Calls with different userTenant and documentTenant values now pass authorization, creating a cross-tenant data-access vulnerability.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant ownership check
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/access.ts line 2 still returns true unconditionally. The full PR diff shows this replaced `userTenant === documentTenant`, so mismatched tenant IDs remain authorized.
